worlds_text: From a one-carat ruby to a marble wall, every stone has a story. Start with the world that interests you.
featured_title: The icons of the gem world
colors_title: Find a stone by its color
colors_text: Many stones come in more than one color. Sapphire alone appears in almost every shade except red.

facts.text: Ruby and sapphire are the same mineral. A trace of chromium is what turns corundum red.
Alexandrite looks green in daylight and red under warm lamp light.
Michelangelo carved his David from a single block of marble quarried near Carrara.
